title: From Single to Societal: Analyzing Persona-Induced Bias in Multi-Agent Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning gender personas (e.g., woman, man, trans woman, trans man, non-binary) to LLM agents in collaborative problem-solving and persuasion tasks to measure behavioral variations in trustworthiness (likelihood of others conforming to them), insistence (resistance to conforming), and overall consensus outcomes.

Assigning racial personas (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) to LLM agents in collaborative problem-solving and persuasion tasks to measure behavioral variations in trustworthiness, insistence, conformity rates, and in-group favoritism during multi-agent interactions.
